judge.rationale: The candidate makes the exact same production code fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` as the reference, adds an equivalent unit test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and updates all line-number references in the spec files accurately. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including removing the recorded flaw from `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, documenting what `afterSession` can assume on a `beforeSession` throw, and adding a CHANGELOG entry with a migration note. However, the candidate regresses the status of `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` from `Shipped` to `In Progress` because the prose paragraph it added under `## Lifecycle failure guarantee` lacks a `[validated by: ...]` link, and it leaves behind an unnecessary `.lore/dod.md` file and a redundant `chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts` file.
